Shanghai/Ningbo.waitLabel: SHA 8-9.5 days · NGB 5-6 days before shutdown (SEKO, 27 Aug)
Shanghai/Ningbo.note: Both halves of the pair are still shut. Shanghai is under mandatory port closure — Yangshan from 26 Aug 18:00 HKT and Waigaoqiao from 27 Aug 00:01 HKT, with no new berthing windows granted; SIPG shut Yangshan empty gates 27 Aug 04:00 and laden gates 27 Aug 06:00 HKT, and Waigaoqiao/domestic-trade empty gates from 27 Aug 14:00 HKT. Ningbo-Zhoushan remains under Ningbo MSA Level III emergency response with empty gate-in and pick-up stopped from 26 Aug 16:00 and laden from 26 Aug 20:00 HKT across Beilun 1-3, Daxie, Meishan/MSICT, Yongzhou and Zhensi; resumption will be announced only after post-storm structural inspections. Waits going into the shutdown were 9.5 days at WGQ5, 9 at WGQ2 and 8 at Yangshan 1-2, Ningbo 5-6 days, Meishan yard at 100 percent and over 139 boxships in the outer anchorages. Saudel made landfall between Sanmen in eastern Zhejiang and Xiapu in southeastern Fujian on the morning of 28 Aug HKT and JMA has it decaying to a tropical storm within 12 hours and a depression within 24; no source has yet reported gates reopening. Yangtze barge relays and coastal feeders are halted and the Donghai, Hangzhou Bay and Zhoushan cross-sea bridges face wind closures.
Shanghai/Ningbo.source: SEKO Asia-Pacific Logistics Monitoring Center, 27 Aug 2026 17:00 HKT; JMA TC2621 specifications, 28 Aug 2026 06:45 JST

Xiamen.note: Fujian gateways are in direct typhoon preparation — vessel tie-downs and anchorage dispersals, coastal and island ferries halted — and Saudel came ashore just up the coast at Xiapu. Container operations at Xiamen have not been suspended: Toll's local team reports no impact and SEKO lists no gate closure. Closest JMA forecast approach is 373 km at 12 hours as the system weakens inland.
Xiamen.source: SEKO Asia-Pacific Logistics Monitoring Center, 27 Aug 2026 17:00 HKT; Toll Global Forwarding advisory, 26 Aug 2026; JMA TC2621 specifications, 28 Aug 2026 06:45 JST

remarks: Saudel is the operative system. It made landfall on the Zhejiang-Fujian border on the morning of 28 Aug HKT and JMA downgrades it to a tropical storm by +12h and a depression by +24h, so the reopening decision at Shanghai and Ningbo should land within a day.

Shanghai/Ningbo is the worst possible port for this to hit right now: 1.53m TEU sitting at anchorage and a queue-to-berth ratio of 2.68 on the latest Linerlytica snapshot, on top of a backlog never fully cleared from Typhoon Dolphin earlier in August.
Etau and the unnamed TC2626 are both far out in the western Pacific near Wake Island, thousands of kilometres from any tracked port. No threat this week.
Narra has cleared the JMA feed; the watch it carried over Haiphong and Shenzhen is closed with no operational impact recorded.
Linerlytica has published no congestion snapshot since 23 Aug, so the queue figures behind these judgements are five days old.
